About.title: About Vishal Junnar Pathpedhi
About.subtitle: A proud legacy of cooperative unity, financial resilience, and community welfare since 1978.
About.historyDesc: The Vishal Junnar family was founded on the auspicious day of Gudi Padwa in April 1978, born out of social commitment by the passionate youth of Junnar who came to Mumbai to earn their livelihood. By collecting three nominal subscriptions of ₹6 each from 550 founding members, a share capital of ₹1,32,500 was mobilized. The society was formally inaugurated in January 1979 in the esteemed presence of the then Minister of State for Home Affairs, Hon. Bhai Vaidya. Despite historical challenges including the 1983 Mumbai mill workers' strike, the society has grown with unshakeable integrity over the past 46 years into an 'A' class audited model credit institution in Maharashtra.
About.visionDesc: To empower every family, worker, farmer, and entrepreneur in Junnar, Mumbai, and Maharashtra with financial inclusion, ethical cooperative credit, and sustainable wealth creation.
About.missionDesc: To deliver rapid doorstep banking, maintain continuous 'A' Class audit excellence, adopt modern web-based core banking, and uplift members through educational scholarships and medical welfare.
About.directorsSubtitle: Guided by experienced, visionary leaders dedicated to transparent cooperative governance
About.socialDesc: In January 2012, the society established 'Vishal Junnar Pratishthan' trust. We provide educational scholarships from Class 4 through Postgraduate degrees, up to ₹1,00,000 financial aid for incurable illnesses and accidental deaths, career counseling camps, and agricultural welfare seminars.

Testimonials.t2Text: I have been investing in the Vishal Samruddhi and Damdidpat schemes for over 15 years. Their interest rates are higher than commercial banks and 100% dependable.
